report:
Breast, right, total mastectomy

The specimen consists of a right total mastectomy specimen (1450 g, 220 x 180 x 90 mm) with an overlying skin ellipse (200 x 90 mm). Sectioning reveals a fleshy, lobulated, with leaf-like clefts, haemorrhagic, necrotic tumour measuring 120 mm in greatest dimension (120 x 100 x 85 mm) in the central breast, 8 mm from the posterior margin. Gritty, bone-hard areas are present within the tumour. Two lymph nodes are identified and entirely embedded.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total mastectomy
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour site: Central
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 120 mm (120 x 100 x 85 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Phyllodes tumour, malignant
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a fibroepithelial tumour measuring 120 mm with leaf-like fronds
  lined by a bland bilayered epithelium and marked stromal cellularity, marked
  stromal atypia and stromal overgrowth; mitoses number 18 per 10 high power
  fields. The stroma forms a malignant spindle cell proliferation resembling a
  sarcoma, and the epithelial component is sparse and displaced by the stromal
  growth. The border is extensively infiltrative into the surrounding breast.
  Malignant heterologous elements are present (osteosarcoma). The features are
  those of a malignant phyllodes tumour.
- Stromal cellularity: Marked (many overlapping stromal nuclei)
- Stromal atypia: Marked (marked nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and
  irregular nuclear contours)
- Stromal overgrowth: Present
- Mitotic rate: 18 per 10 high power fields
- Histologic tumour border: Infiltrative (permeative), extensive
- Malignant heterologous elements: Osteosarcoma
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Epithelial component: Bland bilayered epithelium

Surgical margins
- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: 8 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm

Regional lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: Sentinel node biopsy only
- Number of lymph nodes examined: 2 (sentinel)
- Number of lymph nodes involved: 0

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3 pN0

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Not identified

BREAST, right, total mastectomy
- MALIGNANT PHYLLODES TUMOUR with osteosarcoma, 120 mm; margins clear (closest
  8 mm, posterior); see synoptic report
- 0 of 2 sentinel lymph nodes involved
- pT3 pN0 (AJCC 8th edition)

Malignant phyllodes tumours are usually excised with a clear margin of at least 10 mm; the 8 mm posterior margin is noted for the clinical team's consideration of re-excision.
